property_summary: For any call to transfer that does not revert, the return value must be true; the mutant always returns false, violating this invariant.
For any non-reverting call to transfer, the return value equals true if and only if the internal call to transferFrom succeeds; the mutant always returns false.
For any non-reverting call to transfer, the return value must be true; the mutant returns false for some admissible input.
For any input where the external call to caddress does not revert, transfer in C returns true; the mutant always returns false when the call does not revert.
